candidate: Feedback-constrained sparse revision of noisy reference inputs followed by symbolic refitting.

screen.comparison: Same hypotheses, input-relaxation options and ranking in both selectors; only actual earlier failed-setting constraints differ.
screen.scope: Local single-reading perturbation family on displayed 0.01 grid; ranges are empirical search limits, not statistical confidence bounds. No global optimality claim.

native.scope: One selected historical Challenge seed24 failure. All 264 prefix actions replayed independently for each method. Public physical checkpoint fields match. Selector inputs remain the same historical observations; newly drawn noise is logged but not used to reselect. This is not four independent test worlds or new autonomous full-task learning.

supply_and_feedback.supplied: Existing expression grammar, isolated radiation readings, displayed 0.01 grid, single-entry input-relaxation family, model-complexity penalty, native2Hz activation tolerance, collection/navigation/parsers.
supply_and_feedback.feedback_used: Only actual failed target setpoints observed before calibration; post-calibration outcomes and hidden target frequencies are not inputs.
supply_and_feedback.hypothetical_input: 10.08 is a candidate latent reference value inferred from a measured minimum10.09, not a fabricated observed reading. No remeasurement took place in this screen; the resulting model was evaluated by real native tuning.

review.assessment: The proposal provides no demonstrated separating causal cut. Zero finite-difference/first-order influence alone does not prove finite-update invariance in a nonlinear graph, and the residual dimensions/update are underspecified. It was not used as experimental evidence or implemented as an accepted new method.

prior_art.title: Learning programs by learning from failures
prior_art.scope: Generate-test-constrain and generalisation/specialisation pruning are prior operations.

prior_art.title: Learning logic programs by explaining their failures
prior_art.scope: Failing subprograms refine the hypothesis space beyond rejecting the whole program. Our numeric finite-model filter is not a reproduction of Hempel.

headline_cn: 反证驱动读数修正候选未超过匹配的测量误差拟合；普通模型排除也修复了选定的原生失败案例。
report_note_cn: 新增离线候选操作允许将一个参考读数解释为邻近的潜在值，然后重新拟合，并用此前实际失败的调谐结果约束模型。在4份真实记录（2个世界各2次运行）、4档复杂度惩罚下，加入反证均未改变匹配的测量误差拟合器的选择。对原先失败的Challenge种子24检查点，又分别重放264个原生动作并执行4种冻结选择：普通重拟合失败；有限候选模型排除成功（38个续跑动作）；普通测量误差拟合与候选均成功（各37个续跑动作，动作序列完全一致）。因此候选的额外操作没有带来收益，不作为新方法，不继续扩量。这里只有1个选定历史检查点；输入修正是待检验的潜在值假设，没有伪装成实际读数。
decision: Retire this proposed feedback-evidence-revision operator as a contribution on the tested family. Retain the simple finite-model-elimination and noisy-input comparators. Stop expanding Reactor measurement/calibration variants as a novelty search. A new direction must specify a substantive changed learning operation and demonstrate a native benefit beyond the closest concrete baseline before scale-up.
